name: 电咩咩
evolution: 电咩咩 → 粉咩咩 Lv.30 → 电球咩咩 Lv.42
description: 整个咩咩非常蓬松，每一根蓬松的毛都带电，稍微靠近它就要被静电“哔哩”一下。释放能量之后会进入低电量状态，低电量时会没精打采并吃很多。
descriptionEn: This creature is extremely fluffy, and every strand of its fur carries a charge — get a little too close and you will get zapped by static. After discharging energy it enters a low-battery state, becoming listless and eating a great deal.

skills.name: 球状闪电
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%. Counters attacks.

skills.name: 远程访问
skills.descriptionEn: Forces the enemy creature to return to the field.

skills.name: 感电
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每离场1次，本技能使用次数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. Each time it leaves the field, this skill's number of uses permanently +1.

skills.name: 电离爆破
skills.description: 敌方获得魔攻-20%，速度-20，2连击。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy loses 20% magic attack and 20 speed, and this skill hits 2 times.

skills.name: 集中
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己回合结束返场。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%. Counters attacks: it returns to the field at the end of the turn.

skills.name: 落雷
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次入场，本技能威力永久+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. Each time it enters the field, this skill's power permanently +40.

skills.name: 闪击折返
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage with 2 hits, then it withdraws.

skills.name: 电磁偏转
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：下回合所选技能使用次数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%. Counters attacks: the selected skill next turn gains +1 use.

skills.name: 强制重启
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：回合结束时使敌方精灵返场。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. Counters status: at the end of the turn, forces the enemy creature to return to the field.
